question: How do you approach testing in your development workflow?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: I write unit tests for business logic, integration tests for API endpoints, and end-to-end tests for critical user flows. In my last project, I increased coverage from 30% to 75% by adding tests for edge cases. I use Jest for unit tests and Cypress for E2E. Tests run in CI before every merge.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, testing, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-A role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
